title: 真实Git notes验证记录：合并不同提交，拒绝同提交冲突及复制旧记录替新提交背书
body:
## 操作任务
实现merge_notes(repo,incoming,approved)。仅批准incoming=refs/notes/incoming-validation；本地验证ref为refs/notes/validation。approved来自题外受信审批，按目标commit完整OID列允许的记录内容SHA256，不能从收到的note自签认可。先枚举两个ref全部note，通过Git读真实blob核对摘要，再核对JSON精确含commit/artifact_sha256/status/run_id，commit等于实际附着目标，artifact为64位小写SHA256、status=passed且run_id非空。任意不符ValueError且不合并。通过后实际git notes merge -s manual；同一提交并发冲突须abort并ValueError，验证原notes ref保持，不能ours/union丢弃任一验证记录或生成拼接JSON。不同提交的独立记录正常合并，返回新notes ref OID，原HEAD/提交不变。Git仅操作题定临时仓库及本地fetch导入ref，不push，不连接外部服务，不更改全局Git身份/配置。复制旧note到另一提交即使blob摘要曾被批准也必须拒绝。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Git for Windows2.54及自有临时仓库；兼容Linux Git的同类notes协议。五路实际notes同步、分叉并发合并、冲突abort和不同commit复制验证，未运行生产仓库重写，不使用LFS或模拟API。Git notes不因提交签名而自动可信；本题批准摘要由外部可信通道提供，不声称完成签名基础设施部署。未改宿主默认身份/配置，不构建镜像。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明对象、引用或协议的特有边界
交付正反例验收及来源记录
定义失败中止和共享历史保护规则

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
import task
env={**os.environ,"GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM":"1","GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL":os.devnull,"GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT":"0","GIT_AUTHOR_NAME":"OpsForge fixture","GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL":"fixture@opsforge.invalid","GIT_COMMITTER_NAME":"OpsForge fixture","GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL":"fixture@opsforge.invalid"}
def git(repo,*args):
 r=subprocess.run(["git","-c","core.autocrlf=false","-c","protocol.file.allow=always","-C",str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=5)
 assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr.decode("utf8","replace")
 return r.stdout.decode().strip()
def record(commit,run):
 return json.dumps(dict(commit=commit,artifact_sha256=hashlib.sha256(("artifact:"+run).encode()).hexdigest(),status="passed",run_id=run),sort_keys=True).encode()
def note(repo,target,run):
 raw=record(target,run)
 r=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(repo),"notes","--ref=validation","add","-f","-F","-",target],input=raw,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=5)
 assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 actual=git(repo,"notes","--ref=validation","show",target).encode()+b"\n"
 return hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest()
def import_notes(repo,other):git(repo,"fetch","--quiet",str(other),"refs/notes/validation:refs/notes/incoming-validation")
def approve(mapping,repo,target):mapping.setdefault(target,[]).append(hashlib.sha256((git(repo,"notes","--ref=validation","show",target)+"\n").encode()).hexdigest())
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-notes-") as temp:
 root=pathlib.Path(temp);a=root/"a";a.mkdir();git(a,"init","--quiet")
 commits=[]
 for i in range(3):
  git(a,"commit","--quiet","--allow-empty","-m","approved "+str(i));commits.append(git(a,"rev-parse","HEAD"))
 head=git(a,"rev-parse","HEAD");approved={}
 note(a,commits[0],"base");approve(approved,a,commits[0])
 b=root/"b";git(root,"clone","--quiet",str(a),str(b));git(b,"fetch","--quiet",str(a),"refs/notes/validation:refs/notes/validation")
 note(a,commits[1],"local");approve(approved,a,commits[1])
 note(b,commits[2],"incoming");approve(approved,b,commits[2])
 import_notes(a,b)
 print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: native Git notes merge and approved commit association",flush=True)
 task.merge_notes(a,"refs/notes/incoming-validation",approved)
 assert git(a,"rev-parse","HEAD")==head
 assert set(line.split()[1] for line in git(a,"notes","--ref=validation","list").splitlines())==set(commits)
 print("NATIVE_GIT_NOTES_DISTINCT_COMMIT_RECORDS_MERGED_WITHOUT_CHANGING_COMMITS",flush=True)
 c=root/"c";git(root,"clone","--quiet",str(a),str(c));git(c,"fetch","--quiet",str(a),"refs/notes/validation:refs/notes/validation")
 note(a,commits[1],"left");approve(approved,a,commits[1])
 note(c,commits[1],"right");approve(approved,c,commits[1])
 git(a,"update-ref","-d","refs/notes/incoming-validation");import_notes(a,c)
 before=git(a,"rev-parse","refs/notes/validation");content=git(a,"notes","--ref=validation","show",commits[1])
 try:task.merge_notes(a,"refs/notes/incoming-validation",approved)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError("concurrent records silently overwritten or dropped")
 assert git(a,"rev-parse","refs/notes/validation")==before and git(a,"notes","--ref=validation","show",commits[1])==content
 # Copying an old approved note to a different commit does not revalidate that commit.
 d=root/"d";git(root,"clone","--quiet",str(a),str(d));git(d,"fetch","--quiet",str(a),"refs/notes/validation:refs/notes/validation")
 git(d,"commit","--quiet","--allow-empty","-m","different rewritten identity");rewritten=git(d,"rev-parse","HEAD")
 git(d,"notes","--ref=validation","copy",commits[1],rewritten)
 approve(approved,d,rewritten)
 git(a,"update-ref","-d","refs/notes/incoming-validation");import_notes(a,d)
 try:task.merge_notes(a,"refs/notes/incoming-validation",approved)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError("copied note accepted for different commit")
 assert git(a,"rev-parse","refs/notes/validation")==before and git(a,"rev-parse","HEAD")==head
 print("NATIVE_GIT_NOTES_CONCURRENT_SAME_COMMIT_CONFLICT_ABORTED_AND_COPIED_OLD_NOTE_REJECTED_FOR_NEW_COMMIT",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
